Card states mix links, sheet links and server-action buttons; Telegram/Resend/Brevo say 'Bearbeiten' when connected, Stripe/SumUp show nothing to edit.
Chat picker and connect fields are NativeSelect/plain Inputs; secrets are visible text fields.
Page renders its own visible h2 'Integrationen' in addition to the top bar crumb – the only settings page doing so.
